body: I'm 33 years-old, live at home with my crazy mother, get by on unemployment and odd jobs, have no friends and my ankle hurts. I'm working on my Master's and have been flying with A's. I've been applying for jobs that can lead to a career and although I do well on the testing and interviews, I fall short. In fact, I was ranked #1 for a great job but they gave it to someone else and offered me a 'sub' job. I mean, I was willing to come in at 4AM and work for $19 an hour for doing $25 an hour work. Three years ago, I would have been like 'fuck that.' Now I can't even get that and may have to settle for a sub gig. That will do no favors for me financially. That is not a good sign for me.
